decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered its target interest rate by 50 basis points to a range of 3 percent.

changes.quote: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to lower its target for the federal funds rate 50 basis points to 3 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed reduced the size of its rate cut to 50 basis points compared to the larger 75 basis point cut made previously.

changes.quote: Financial markets remain under considerable stress, and credit has tightened further for some businesses and households.
changes.explanation: The language was updated to note that financial markets remain stressed, dropping mention of easing short-term funding markets.

changes.quote: Today’s policy action, combined with those taken earlier, should help to promote moderate growth over time and to mitigate the risks to economic activity.
changes.explanation: A new phrase was added to emphasize that current and past rate cuts are intended to support growth and protect the economy.

changes.quote: In a related action, the Board of Governors unanimously approved a 50-basis-point decrease in the discount rate to 3-1/2 percent.
changes.explanation: The emergency lending rate charged to banks was also lowered by 50 basis points, mirroring the main policy rate reduction.

tone_quotes.quote: Financial markets remain under considerable stress, and credit has tightened further for some businesses and households.
Moreover, recent information indicates a deepening of the housing contraction as well as some softening in labor markets.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 13.59% APR, a 50 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $2.08.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.78% and moved +9 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 5.69% would rise by about $17.14 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $30.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 5%, and employers added an average of 99k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 4.1% over the past year (December 2007); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.4%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.5% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +1 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.1% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Committee will continue to monitor financial developments and act in a timely manner as needed to address downside risks to growth. According to educational forecast models, the next meeting has a 61% probability of a hold and a 39% probability of a cut.
